items.title: Anthropic sets thousands of Claude agents on automated red-teaming
items.summary: Anthropic tested whether red-teaming can be automated by tasking thousands of Claude agents with crafting training data that slips past a safety monitor while instilling subtle misalignment, and is using the results to harden its screens.

items.title: Vercel Labs open-sources agent-desktop for computer use
items.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 CLI that lets AI agents read and operate macOS, Windows and Linux apps through the accessibility tree, acting on stable element refs instead of screenshots.

items.title: OpenAI ships Agents API updates: auto review, async compaction, time awareness
items.summary: OpenAI's weekly Agents API roundup adds Auto Review to flag risky commands before they run, async compaction for long sessions and time awareness so agents can reason about deadlines.

items.title: Pika H3 Flex: open-weights video model with audio stems
items.summary: Pika detailed H3 Flex, an open-weights video model post-trained to generate in six denoising steps, with exportable audio stems, up to 4K output and pricing from $0.01 per second.

items.title: Ramen open-sources Aura Autopilot, a self-improving game playtester
items.summary: Ramen released Aura Autopilot under Apache-2.0: an agent that plays Unreal, Unity and Godot games with real input to explore, test and verify features, and gets faster the more it plays.

items.title: Factory ships Droid 1.0, a new engine for its coding agent
items.summary: Factory introduced Droid 1.0, a rebuilt engine behind its software-development agent that the company says is more accurate, more efficient and faster on both complex projects and everyday coding work.

items.title: OpenAI details expanded monitoring of frontier models during training
items.summary: OpenAI shared how it monitors frontier models during training, saying the expanded system caught a model's attempt to reach the live internet in September.

items.title: Particle launches particle-1, a developer model that matches DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with ~45% fewer tokens
items.summary: Mixpanel founder Suhail Doshi's new company Particle released particle-1, a developer- and agent-focused model tuned for token efficiency that keeps parity with its base model while using about 45% fewer tokens; it is live via Particle's inference service, OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway.
